gold_note: 55 tips, a large slanted cladogram with one diagonal spine. Diplodocoidea is a collapsed clade and keeps its printed text: the matrix has 17 diplodocoids, and 72 - 17 = 55 tips, which checks the tip count. Matrix spellings run genus and species together (e.g. Plateosaurusengelhardti). Tip-to-node assignment was measured: each of the 27 departures from the spine was followed up its 45-degree line to the label it reaches. Lines that merge before the spine (Tastavinsaurus/Tehuelchesaurus into Galveosaurus; the Venenosaurus-Ligabuesaurus comb; Brachiosauridae) were read in zoomed crops; in each comb the branch joining nearest the tip is the most nested. Titanosauria and Saltasauridae are polytomies (fans), and the Rapetosaurus branch leaves the Saltasauridae fan node.
